The structure and content align with standard AUR packaging practices for distributing prebuilt binaries. The use of GoReleaser is noted, which is common for Go-based projects and does not imply malicious intent. All sources are pinned to specific release versions, and checksums are provided for all variants, enhancing reproducibility and trust. No unsafe commands or post-install hooks are present.
